record.title: Microduck left foot cap — yellow 40.1 x 54 x 16.9 printed cap between ankle and sole: 10-rib comb bottom, R16.3 ankle cradle with R16.5 roller relief, two snap fingers, two ankle-block pockets, one M2 pilot
record.origin_why: v0.0.2 is a parametric rebuild: every number in cad/part.py was measured off Pollen Robotics’ decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice intervals/segments and cecad.meshfeatures (probe scripts in out/measure/foot/); nobody has Pollen’s CAD and no physical part has been measured. v0.0.1 (kept) was the vendor mesh loaded as-is.
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-foot-left) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen’s own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/foot_left.stl: p95 0.45/0.33 mm, median 0.000/0.000, bbox delta [-0.001, 0.0, -0.004] mm, 2/2 holes matched. The report is the ledger artifact (evidence/refcheck/).
record.why_this_folder_exists: The left foot of the Microduck is this cap (MJCF places foot_left once, on body ankle_left). Nothing on the shelf is a ribbed sole-backed foot cap with an R16.3 ankle cradle.
